item.title: Itzy’s Chaeryeong steps into spotlight with solo debut ‘Lovesick’
item.description:
Korea Herald • Debut / new group
After nearly eight years with Itzy, Chaeryeong is stepping into the spotlight on her own, hoping to show a side of herself that has taken years to develop. The singer released her first solo EP, “Lovesick,” on Monday, becoming the third Itzy bandmate to pursue a solo career, following Yeji in March 2025 and Yuna in March this year. item.title: Hanroro releases new single 'Question Mark'
item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
Singer-songwriter Hanroro released her new single "Question Mark" on Thursday. The song deals with conflicting emotions in personal relationships, including affection, resentment and regret, continuing Hanroro's exploration of the difficulties and uncertainties of young adulthood.
